ns0:g.ns0:text: Batch distillation enriches withdrawn vapor while the pot loses the volatile component
Differential equilibrium vapor withdrawal, negligible vapor holdup, no reflux, constant relative volatility α=2.5. Decreasing pot x₀=0.60→x=0.30 gives
W/W₀≈0.2479 from Rayleigh integration. Vapor follows the equilibrium curve and is richer in A than the pot; the integral is negative as the pot depletes.
